title: City of San Diego Celebrates Arbor Day at Gompers Neighborhood Park in Chollas View
description: SAN DIEGO – Today the City of San Diego is celebrating Arbor Day with a tree planting event at Gompers Neighborhood Park. City Councilmembers, staff and volunteers, including students from Millennial Tech Middle School, will plant more than 65 trees in the park and street trees in the surrounding neighborhood.
